metadata.title: Mustard Green and Potato stir fry with                        Maggi Masala-ae-Magic
metadata.description: "Join me on my journey as I whip up my ultimate comfort food: Potato Mustard Green Stir Fry! This humble side dish complements rotis and rice perfectly, bringing simplicity and deliciousness to every meal. With the help of MAGGI Masala-ae-Magic, this dish becomes an extraordinary culinary delight, easy to make and bursting with flavor. Give it a try to elevate your dining experience!"
